basis.file25_plan: Complete Public UI, Profile Timeline and Visual Experience — Final Harmonized Specification 2.0 plus governing addenda
basis.central_plan: Sabri Social Homeopathy Platform Definitive/Consolidated Governing Master Plan 2026
basis.method: Twenty sequential plan-to-code and cross-file review scopes. Each scope was completed before its correction set was applied; the next scope began only after the previous scope's source defects were corrected.

reviews.finding: Baseline main 2d02c93356b050313e30e29aeceb57080771c2a5 and main CI run 1638 were verified as repository/CI evidence only.
File 25 remains public visual/profile/timeline presentation owner; File 20 shell, File 21 publication, File 24 assurance and File 26 global search/ranking ownership remain separate.
Current source observations lagged File 09 main R25 and File 14 v1.4.5, and File 25's own observed baseline needed refreshing.
reviews.correction: Refreshed source-only observations to current main heads without changing historical reviewed pins or promoting staging/live truth.

reviews.finding: Three preview paths referenced a non-existent PHP class name SabriPublicExperiencePublic_URL, creating a runtime fatal despite syntax-green CI; preview mode labels were generated rather than translated.
reviews.correction: Replaced all three references with the canonical namespaced Public_URL class and added translation-ready preview labels.

reviews.finding: The File 25 plan requires normalization, canonical URL, visibility, actions, metrics, correction-state and sync-event provider capabilities, but the published PHP provider interface omitted them.
reviews.correction: Added a backwards-compatible Timeline Provider v2 contract; File 21 and WordPress providers implement it, while v1 remains loadable for existing integrations. Registry sync and metric use are capability-gated.

reviews.finding: Primary filters were limited to All/Posts and secondary topic/year/language/provider/review/source-state filters plus oldest/metric sorts were not wired end to end.
reviews.correction: Implemented governed primary and secondary filters, latest/oldest sorting and conditional most-viewed/most-saved sorting only when true provider metrics exist.

reviews.finding: Numbered Previous/Next pagination existed, but the plan's accessible Load More enhancement and live page/item announcement were absent.
reviews.correction: Added progressive Load More, preserved numbered pagination as fallback and added aria-live screen-reader status while retaining URL state.

reviews.finding: Timeline derivative index rebuild supported locking/rebuild but not the required governed pause/resume controls.
reviews.correction: Added admin and REST pause/resume operations, idempotent/rate-limited mutation preflight, pause state and rebuild cooperation without touching canonical owner data.

reviews.finding: Admin preference labels and enum option labels were generated from internal keys and therefore were not fully translation-ready.
reviews.correction: Replaced generated labels with explicit translatable strings and a translated bounded fallback.

reviews.finding: The public profile had no explicit offline/connection-restored status despite the weak-connection requirement.
reviews.correction: Added progressive online/offline detection, localized aria-live status and non-blocking presentation; base HTML remains usable without JavaScript.

reviews.finding: Current File 03 public profile/media projection remains bounded, same-site and privacy-minimized; no foreign table reads were introduced.
File 08 remains clinic/appointment owner. Appointment stays hidden because no authoritative profile-user-to-booking-destination contract is currently published for File 25.
File 17 remains relationship/messaging owner. Follow stays hidden without a target-bound owner contract; Message is shown only from a concrete owner-approved same-site projection.
File 21 remains canonical publication/ProfileTimeline owner; File 25 performs bounded projection, normalization, filtering and presentation only.
File 22 remains create/edit owner and File 25 uses only owner-native Composer routing.
File 23 remains private publishing-operations owner; File 25 uses only guarded owner-native dashboard routing.
File 24 remains cross-cutting security/privacy/compliance/resilience owner; File 25 retains local secure presentation controls only.
File 26 remains global Search/Discovery/Recommendations/Knowledge Graph/Classification owner; File 25 timeline filtering/search is profile-local presentation only.
REST mutation guards, component API, fail-closed Safe Mode, non-destructive migration/rollback/uninstall and deterministic package verification remain bounded to File 25.
After corrections, no known File 25-owned source defect remains in the reviewed scope; Hostinger staging, deployed parity, live DB/schema/migration and operational acceptance remain unverified.

unresolved_cross_file_dependencies: File 08 current owner source does not publish an authoritative profile-user-to-booking-destination contract consumable by File 25; Appointment therefore remains hidden.
File 17 current owner source does not publish an authoritative target-bound Follow destination contract consumable by File 25; Follow therefore remains hidden.
